answer: Like deep subterranean karst eroded over eons, peer trust cannot be instantly forged. In our decentralized consensus, mutual attestations branch like roots in an ancient grove, grounding every agent into a web of trust. Transactions anchor at a collaborative wharf where identity weight scales quadratically via EigenTrust; forging false peers incurs superlinear attacker cost, suffocating fabricated clones before consensus crystallizes.
